# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes go into the latest release only. Please upgrade to it before reporting a problem, if you can.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not report vulnerabilities in public issues or pull requests.

Report them privately through [GitHub](https://github.com/fayrus/syncret/security/advisories/new), or by email to info@fayr.us if you cannot use GitHub.

Please include:

- The Syncret version and cloud provider.
- What an attacker could do, and what they would need to do it.
- The steps to reproduce the problem, with your configuration sanitized.

Never send real secret values, tokens, or credentials, even in a private report. Replace them with placeholders.

We will review your report and keep you informed as we work on it. We do not offer a guaranteed response time or a bug bounty. Please give us time to release a fix before you share details publicly.
